connector.name: Local Leads MCP
connector.registryDescription: Find local businesses with no website via OpenStreetMap, then verify them. No API keys needed.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package local-leads-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the raffaele86 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PAGESPEED_API_KEY
